verdict.rationale: The MI325X is documented as a datacenter AI/HPC accelerator: an OAM module in 8-GPU server configurations, built on the CDNA 3 compute architecture and targeted by ROCm for AI and HPC workloads. High-refresh 4K consumer gaming is outside this product's category, and the evidence shows no gaming capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a gamer, this card drives high-refresh 4K gaming — vendor performance claims corroborated by independent game benchmarks
